access_request_not_found: The access request was not found in this tenant. Refresh the request list and verify its identifier.
access_request_role_not_found: The requested role no longer exists in this tenant. Choose an available role and submit a new request.
access_request_expired: The access request or approved grant has expired. Submit a new request with a future access end time.
access_request_requester_inactive: Only an active tenant member can request access. Restore the tenant membership before trying again.
access_already_granted: This role is already assigned to the requester. No additional access request is needed.
access_request_state_conflict: The access request was already decided or changed. Refresh it before taking another action.
access_request_self_approval: Requesters cannot approve or reject their own access requests. Another authorized approver must decide it.
access_request_requester_only: Only the original requester can withdraw this access request or relinquish its approved access.
invalid_access_request: The access request is invalid. Choose an existing role, provide a clear reason, and set an access end time within 365 days.
human_principal_required: This operation requires an authenticated human principal. Service accounts and OAuth clients cannot request, approve, or review access.
governance_unavailable: The access governance service is temporarily unavailable. No governance change was committed; try again later.
access_review_not_found: The access review was not found in this tenant. Refresh the review list and verify its identifier.
access_review_item_not_found: The selected access review item was not found. Refresh the review before deciding it.
access_review_expired: The access review deadline has passed. Create a new review to certify current access.
access_review_empty: There are no active direct or temporary tenant role grants to review.
access_review_state_conflict: The access review or item was already changed. Refresh it before taking another action.
access_review_incomplete: Every access review item must be kept or revoked before the review can be completed.
access_review_self_decision: Reviewers cannot certify their own access. Another authorized reviewer must decide this item.
access_review_last_administrator: This decision would remove the tenant's last durable administrator. Assign another administrator before revoking this access.
invalid_access_review: The access review is invalid. Provide a clear name, a deadline within 365 days, and a valid keep or revoke decision.
access_review_derived_not_revocable: Rule-derived group access cannot be revoked per user. Change the group rule or remove the role binding from the group, then re-run the review.
